# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We test the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with specific parameters: volume expansion (vol_mult=1.3), minimum body size (5 cents), at least 2 stars, ITM-2 strike (strike_offset=2), and requiring a break above the open. The hypothesis is that this parameter set captures edge by filtering for high-quality breakouts with strong institutional participation, avoiding false breaks in choppy conditions.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger fires when: (1) volume >= 1.3 × 20-bar average volume, (2) candle body >= $0.05, (3) star score >= 2, (4) strike = ITM-2 put (strike_offset=2), (5) break above open (require_break_above_open=true). **Exit:** Premium stop at -8% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +40% premium (selling 2/3 of position via tp1_qty_fraction=0.667), runner target at +150% premium, profit lock arms immediately at entry (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0) with 5% trailing stop offset (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05). Time stop at 15:50 ET.
